categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Julong Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: high-performance modified plastics, thermoplastic elastomer materials, carbon fiber composite structural parts and components manufacturing with assembly, and bio-based recycled plastic wood profiles. These products serve industries including automotive and new energy vehicles, high-speed rail and rail transit, communications and electronics, aerospace and low-altitude economy, medical health, and environmental construction engineering.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer modification technologies including physical and chemical methods to enhance plastics. It employs dynamic vulcanization ('three-step method') for thermoplastic elastomers and advanced manufacturing techniques for carbon fiber reinforced resin composites, including automated fiber placement and thermal diaphragm molding. Production processes include extrusion, injection molding, and composite material fabrication, with ongoing R&D in high-performance materials such as PA, PP, PEEK, PPS, and bio-based composites.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers (both traditional and new energy vehicle makers), high-speed rail and urban rail transit companies, communications and electronics firms, aerospace and low-altitude economy enterprises, medical device manufacturers, and environmental construction projects. The company has established long-term partnerships with major domestic and international automotive brands and suppliers, as well as clients in the aerospace and communications sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Nanjing, Yangzhou, Chuzhou, and Guangdong. It has expanded internationally with wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the USA (Texas), and Mexico, targeting North American markets. Domestic sales are concentrated in eastern China, with significant presence in other regions including Northeast, North China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Julong operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of advanced polymer materials and composite components. It sources raw materials such as nylon and polypropylene from upstream chemical producers and supplies finished materials and components to downstream manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, electronics, and construction industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-performance polymer materials, focusing on lightweight, flame-retardant, low-odor, and environmentally friendly materials. R&D priorities include advanced modified nylons, thermoplastic elastomers with enhanced sealing and noise reduction properties, carbon fiber composites for aerospace and low-altitude economy applications, and bio-based recycled plastic wood products. It also invests in precision electronic materials and human-like robot materials, aligning with national strategies for new materials and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance modified plastics, thermoplastic elastomers, carbon fiber composite parts, and bio-based plastic wood products. The company employs a direct sales model domestically and combines direct and trade sales internationally, providing technical support and integrated material solutions to customers. Revenue streams include product sales to automotive OEMs, rail transit companies, electronics manufacturers, and construction sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanjing Julong is positioned as a leading domestic enterprise in the modified plastics and advanced composite materials industry, recognized as a key supplier for automotive and high-speed rail sectors. It competes with both domestic and international material suppliers, with competitive advantages in proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and strategic global production layout. The company is acknowledged as a national high-tech enterprise and a 'little giant' in specialized and innovative SMEs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.39 billion, representing a 30.53% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 84.34 million, up 16.25%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with expanding production capacity and international market penetration. It maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 2.38 billion and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Julong differentiates itself through its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and ability to provide customized, high-performance polymer solutions tailored to demanding applications in automotive, aerospace, and electronics. Its products emphasize lightweight, durability, flame retardancy, low odor, and environmental sustainability. The company integrates advanced manufacturing technologies and offers comprehensive technical support, enabling it to meet stringent customer requirements and foster long-term partnerships.
